read: 2026-11-22, by eye at 3× zoom with a 20 px grid
imageryNote: Esri World Imagery export kept in the repo (600 Web Mercator metres ≈ 564 ground metres across 1024 px, ≈ 0.55 m per pixel). Capture date unknown. Roofs of tall blocks lean away from the image centre (relief displacement), so roof centres can sit several metres off their footprints.
method: Each point pairs the centre of a feature in campus data (footprint centre) with the centre of the same feature as read on the image. These are human image readings, not survey: sigma is the reader's honest uncertainty in metres.
